note.zh-TW: 對應資產負債表的短期放貨（T09）；公司資金貸與他人受公司法第 15 條限制。
note.en: Corresponds to short-term loans receivable on the statement of financial position (T09); lending company funds to others is restricted by Article 15 of the Company Act.

definition.zh-TW: 公司把錢借給別人時付出的現金。本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: Cash paid out when the company lends money to others. The course story does not use it.
